about: L1: the static site no longer reads this legacy order-form switch. Prices live in data/pricing.json (republished from portal/lib/pricing.json; since 2026-11-07: The Social Kit $15 once, Stay Visible $25 and Keep Growing $40 a month, each at 50% off a doubled list price, in SAR / AED / EGP by country); the checkout backend reads its copy of portal/lib/pricing.json and charges the selected plan's amount in the buyer's currency. Additional platform charges are zero.
